dedupe_keys.name: heat integration optimisation of a crude distillation unit a python based pinch analysis and techno economic assessment for gcc refinery conditions

description: A refinery research team publishes this related Zenodo release with Python source for a crude-distillation-unit pinch analysis and techno-economic assessment under Gulf refinery conditions. The own page names stream-data extraction from an Arabian Light assay, a Kesler–Lee correlation, a Problem Table Algorithm, figure generation and Monte Carlo analysis. Public files include cdu_stream_data.py and a make_figures script under CC BY 4.0. The model can compare heat-recovery or fuel-price assumptions for refinery process-integration scenarios; a later gas-pricing portfolio explicitly requires it. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code deposit. Round one rejected it as a single-study resource, but executable process-energy code is a reusable model under the current rule. A limitation is that the fuel assay and case assumptions were not checked against plant measurements, and the archived make_figures filename carries a parenthesised suffix different from the dependent README. No source file was executed and no Monte Carlo result was reproduced.
